message.content: Comments in this codebase use lowercase with square-bracket annotations to enforce a consistent, machine-readable format while improving readability for human developers. The lowercase convention avoids case-sensitivity conflicts with identifiers or keywords, ensuring annotations parse reliably across tools. Square brackets `[ ]` serve as delimiters for metadata tags—such as parameter types, expected values, or business logic hints—drawing attention to critical information without interfering with code structure. This hybrid approach balances human-friendly documentation (via clear visual separation) with programmatic utility, allowing linters, documentation generators, or static analysis tools to extract structured data from comments while maintaining a clean, uniform style across the project.
